indicators.flag: A business account receives more than one ERC check deposit over multiple days.
indicators.red_flag: Repeated ERC check deposits to one business account over days
indicators.rationale: Repeated Treasury ERC check deposits to one business account over a short window are fully observable in core deposit data but few banks model the ERC-specific multi-deposit pattern.

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account with two or more Treasury ERC check deposits (identified by F-941/F-943/F-944/F-7200 form codes) posted across multiple days within the window.
build_logic.source: core deposit ledger + Treasury check metadata (form code / lower-left tax quarter)
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → BSA analyst review gate

indicators.flag:
Small business accounts receive an ERC check deposit that is not commensurate with the size
of the business, the number of employees, and the volume of transactions.37
indicators.red_flag: ERC deposit not commensurate with business size / headcount / activity
indicators.rationale: An ERC deposit disproportionate to the account's payroll/employee/transaction footprint is computable from existing account history, but the size-commensurate ratio is rarely operationalized as a signal.

build_logic.logic: Flag when an ERC check deposit amount exceeds a multiple of the account's trailing payroll/transaction volume relative to its estimated headcount, indicating a credit not commensurate with business size.
build_logic.source: core deposit ledger + 12-month account transaction history
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → BSA analyst review gate

indicators.flag:
A large ERC is deposited into a business account and is subsequently transferred using P2P
services or to an online banking institution, or withdrawn as cash at an ATM.  Funds may be
subsequently transferred from the account into separate accounts or payments may be made
to new businesses that a customer has not had transactions with prior to receiving an ERC
check deposit.
indicators.red_flag: Large ERC deposit disbursed (P2P / online-bank / ATM cash) to new counterparties
indicators.rationale: Banks already run rapid-movement-of-funds detection; the enhancement is anchoring the disbursement window specifically to an ERC check deposit event and the novel-counterparty leg.

indicators.flag:
The account receiving an ERC check deposit has no deposits other than Treasury-issued
checks, or the account has no regular business transactions.38
indicators.red_flag: Treasury-check-only funding / no regular business activity
indicators.rationale: Whether an account's only inflows are Treasury checks (no genuine business activity) is directly derivable from the deposit ledger yet is not a standard funnel-account signal.

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account whose deposit history is composed solely (or near-solely) of Treasury-issued checks, or that shows no recurring business transactions, around an ERC check deposit.
build_logic.source: core deposit ledger + account transaction history
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → BSA analyst review gate

indicators.flag:
A customer attempts to deposit an altered Treasury ERC check, or financial institutions are
unable to verify the validity of the checks that customers attempt to deposit.39
indicators.red_flag: Altered or unverifiable ERC check deposit attempt
indicators.rationale: Altered-check and check-validity detection is a mature, established control at the deposit boundary in most mid-size banks.

indicators.flag: The ERC check is deposited into a new business account that did not exist in 2020 or 2021.
indicators.red_flag: ERC deposited to a new business account that did not exist in 2020 or 2021
indicators.rationale: Account-open date versus the eligibility period is a known KYC field; banks flag new accounts but rarely tie account-age to the ERC eligibility window specifically.

indicators.flag:
A new business account is created for an established business, but no other business activity
occurs in the account except the deposit of the ERC.  This may be indicative of identity theft,
where the established business was used as a fraudulent front to file for the ERC.
indicators.red_flag: New ERC-only account on an established business (front / identity-theft pattern)
indicators.rationale: A newly opened account for an established entity whose only activity is the ERC deposit is fully observable in account-open and ledger data but is not a stock signal.

build_logic.logic: Flag a recently opened business account tied to an otherwise established business whose only post-opening activity is an ERC check deposit, consistent with an identity-theft front.
build_logic.source: account-open record + KYC business-age data + post-open transaction ledger
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → BSA analyst review gate

indicators.flag: A dormant business account suddenly receives an ERC check deposit.
indicators.red_flag: Dormant business account reactivated by an incoming ERC deposit
indicators.rationale: Sudden reactivation of a dormant account by an ERC deposit is computable from inactivity history, but dormancy-reactivation tied to the ERC event is not a standard signal.

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account that has been dormant (no activity beyond a long inactivity threshold) and is reactivated by an incoming Treasury ERC check deposit.
build_logic.source: account activity history (dormancy state) + core deposit ledger
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → BSA analyst review gate

indicators.flag: An ERC is deposited into a business account with no payroll history.
indicators.red_flag: ERC deposit into a business account with no payroll history
indicators.rationale: The ERC is a payroll-retention credit, so a deposit into an account that has never run payroll is a strong contradiction that is directly checkable against transaction history but rarely modeled.

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account that receives an ERC check deposit while showing no prior payroll disbursements, contradicting the payroll-retention basis of the credit.
build_logic.source: ACH/payroll disbursement history + core deposit ledger
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → BSA analyst review gate

indicators.flag:
A customer reports or provides documents indicating that their ERC was obtained by a third-
party firm whose credentials cannot be verified or is the subject of adverse media.
indicators.red_flag: ERC obtained via an unverifiable / adverse-media third-party firm
indicators.rationale: Attribution to an unverifiable or adverse-media third-party ERC promoter depends on external adverse-media and preparer-network intelligence the bank does not hold internally.
